description: Add the reporting FastAPI app. FR-C3-01 and FR-C3-07. POST /events stores a valid event, returns 422 for an invalid one, and refuses another org's key.
scope: POST /events returns 201 for a valid body
Missing key returns 401 and a mismatched org returns 403
acceptanceCriteria: Header X-Api-Key maps through api_keys to an org_id. Valid POST /events returns 201 and {"status": "stored"}. action drop returns 422. A key for org-a posting org-b returns 403. A missing header returns 401. FR-C3-01 FR-C3-07.
constraints: Do not return the raw user id or the hash in the POST response.
Do not accept an event whose org_id does not match the key.
Do not add the dashboard page in this task.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. Do not implement later CTX tasks early.
Every test function for this task's subtasks must contain that slice token, for example CTX_007_1.
After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command before ending the turn. Do not stop with explanation text only.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because earlier work implemented it correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
Keep edits inside targetArtifacts unless the subtask explicitly says otherwise.
When writing tests, assert only the current subtask's scope so later subtasks still have meaningful work.
